instruction.text: Many items in our daily lives use magnets. Select the item with a magnet.

feedback.correct: Decorative fridge magnets usually have a button magnet on the back to attach them to the stainless steel surface of fridges.

instruction.text: Kojo bought a fridge magnet to hold up his postcard. Drag the magnet to the area in his kitchen where he could place it.
Kojo’s fridge door is made out of plastic. Do you know where the metal is that lets him attach his fridge magnet?

feedback.finish: The inside of the fridge door is made out of steel, which is a magnetic material. Magnets and magnetic materials are all around us, even when we cannot see them!

instruction.text: Select both of the magnets being used in this image.
Why are the magnets useful here?

feedback.finish: Magnets can be used to hold up non-magnetic objects between themselves and a magnetic material.
